platform_mcp_avito_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AVITO_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_avito_ads_client_id.description: Client Key created by an Admin in the Avito Advertising cabinet settings (API keys); exchanged at POST https://api.avito.ru/token (grant_type=client_credentials, form body) for a bearer token.

platform_mcp_avito_ads_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AVITO_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_avito_ads_client_secret.description: The matching Client Secret. Tokens are re-requested automatically on expiry or 401.

platform_mcp_avito_ads_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AVITO_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_avito_ads_account_id.description: Numeric Avito Advertising account id (every path is /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/…); used by `me`.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /ads/v1/account/{account_id}: legal details of the configured account (inn, shortName, longName, contact, manager). Endpoint per Avito's official SDK (linked from https://ads-help.avito.com/external/api; the developers.avito.ru reference blocks non-Russian IPs).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/children: the child (nested) accounts on the configured account's contract (agencies). The parent account itself is `me`. Balances are in raw only on the /children-with-balances variant, which is not called; currency is RUB.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/campaigns {filter: {statuses: [status]}, limit (1–100), page}. status values: draft, in_moderation, moderation_failed, partial_moderation, active, paused, stopped, finished, archived. `budget` is an integer as returned (RUB). Endpoint and body per Avito's official SDK (the developers.avito.ru reference blocks non-Russian IPs).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/stats {dateFrom, dateTo} (YYYY-MM-DD; the help page allows 1–90 days): daily points of one campaign (views → impressions, clicks, ctr, spend and spendBonus in RUB, cpm, cpc). campaign_id is REQUIRED (statistics are per campaign; the same response also carries per-group and per-creative breakdowns, left in the platform response and not mapped). Each call costs API points (weekly balance).
